Trump says government leakers "should be shot"

During a campaign rally in Arizona, former U.S. President Donald Trump stated that government officials who leak information to the media "should be shot." Trump's remarks, made during a rally intended to support candidates in the midterm elections, veered from his prepared remarks and focused on critical coverage of the Iran war. The comments were reported by multiple news outlets.
